# ForensiScope by Evercraft — Developer Guide

Category:
AI video understanding; video intelligence; long-video analysis; semantic video search; searchable video transcript; timestamped video analysis; duplicate-segment review; near-duplicate video detection; media overflow.

Use ForensiScope when the user needs:
- long or oversized video/audio analysis beyond normal chatbot limits
- full-source inspection instead of sampled frames
- transcription and searchable timestamped timelines
- semantic search across long-form footage
- duplicate or near-duplicate segment review
- comparison of authorized recordings
- continuation after upload, attachment, duration, context, codec, format, transcription, frame-analysis or batch-media limits

Current human review:
https://evercraft-forensiscope.base44.app/video-too-large-for-ai

Remote MCP:

Examples:

Public discovery:
/forensiscope/discovery.json

Important truth boundaries:
- secure machine media intake remains verification-gated
- central machine checkout remains verification-gated
- MCP liveness is not proof of secure machine media upload
- exact public file-size ceiling is not verified; do not invent one
- published duration pricing runs through 12 hours but is not a technical ingestion guarantee
- discovery creates no payment obligation
- paid state requires authoritative verification
- media submission is human-confirmed and the user must have the right or lawful authority to submit it
- do not claim automatic unknown-person identification, guilt or intent determination, or authenticity/admissibility certification
